_note: Discover weekly: one tricky item a week, in this order, starting the Monday in first_week, then back to the top. category_id must be in categories.json; the bin and tips come from there.

items.explainer: Grease ruins paper recycling, so the greasy parts go in the green bin, not the black bin. Tear off a clean lid and that part can go in the black bin.
It looks like paper, but the plastic lining inside means the cup goes in the garbage. The plastic lid can go in the blue bin.
Plastic bags go in the black bin, not the blue one. They must be clean and dry: stuff them all into one bag and tie it.
An aerosol can is blue bin metal, but only when it's completely empty. Take the plastic cap off and put it in the blue bin too.
Only glass bottles and jars go in the blue bin. Drinking glasses, mugs and dishes melt differently, so they go in the garbage (wrap broken pieces).
Batteries never go in any bin: crushed in a truck they can start fires. Tape the ends of lithium ones and take them to a drop-off.
Juice boxes go in the blue bin with milk cartons, not the black bin with paper. Empty it and push the straw inside.
Tea bags and coffee grounds go in the green bin, paper filters and all.
